credentials: PhD, Political Science (Political Theory & International Relations), University of Toronto; collaborative degree in Jewish Studies
bio_summary: Political philosopher, educator, and strategic advisor. Founder of Millerman School, which offers online courses on Plato, Aristotle, Nietzsche, Heidegger, Leo Strauss, and other continental and political philosophers. Through Millerman Intelligence he provides briefings and counsel to investors, founders, and AI organizations on sovereignty, technology, and political philosophy. Leading English-language translator and interpreter of Alexander Dugin (seven major works translated). Consults for hedge funds on political philosophy.
books_authored: Beginning with Heidegger: Strauss, Rorty, Derrida, Dugin and the Philosophical Constitution of the Political
Inside Putin's Brain: The Political Philosophy of Alexander Dugin
audience: Software engineers, startup founders, investors, executives, and serious readers returning to the great books
